description: This file initializes and runs an FTP server within an Odoo module, setting up threading, IP detection, and logging.

classes.name: ftp_server
classes.description: A thread class that manages the FTP server, including IP detection, logging, and server startup.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the FTP channel with specified severity.

methods.name: detect_ip_addr
methods.description: Detects the server's IP address, attempting to handle UNIX and non-UNIX systems.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Configures and starts the FTP server, setting handlers, ports, and logging.
